# cargo-rullst files the pull-request mutation gate (mutants-pr.yml) mutates.
#
# The CLI's integration suites build generated projects, which is too slow to
# repeat for every mutant, so mutants-pr.sh tests these files with the CLI's
# library unit tests only (`cargo test --lib`), the scope of a targeted
# mutants.yml run with test_scope=lib. List a file here once such a run leaves
# no missed mutant, apart from the accepted equivalents in
# mutants-pr-equivalents.txt. Other cargo-rullst files are not mutated.
